The issue would be as to whether the Rules framed by the State Government can be contrary to the Model Rules framed by the Government of India.

"110. Power to make rules.

sentences.text: Section 110 provides for power to make rules.
The power has been given to the State Government apart from Central Government to frame the rules and pursuant to the Act of 2015, the Central Government framed Model Rules in the year 2016.

After framing the Model Rules, the State of Tamil Nadu framed the Rules in the year 2017 which are not at par with the Model Rules, 2016,
though the proviso to Section 110 (1) requires that the rules framed by the State Government should conform the Model Rules and till Rules are framed, the Model Rules to apply mutatis mutandis and thereupon also the State may make Rules conforming to Model Rules.

10. In view of the above, Rules 16 and 17 of the Rules of 2017 framed by the State Government cannot be allowed to stand and in fact, time was prayed and given to the State Government to modify the Rules, but for reasons best known to them, no amendment in the Rules of 2017 has been made and
therefore, we hold both the rules to be illegal to the extent they do not conform to the Model Rules thus offend proviso to Section 110 of the Act of ___________ 2015.

The Rules are,
accordingly, struck down and till they are re- enacted by the State Government, it would be governed by Rule 88(5) and Rule 87 of the Model Rules of 2016.
With the aforesaid, the writ petition is allowed.
There will be no order as to costs.

Consequently,
W.M.P.No.27384 of 2021 is closed.
